name: G1 Dex1 Fold Towel
description: Real Unitree G1 teleoperated dataset of the humanoid folding a towel, recorded with the Dex1 gripper. Includes full G1 state/action: left_arm (7 DoF), right_arm (7 DoF), body, Dex1 gripper, and end-effector poses. Published by Unitree Robotics.
provenance_notes: Verified via WebFetch of the HF dataset card. Apache 2.0 — commercial-friendly. This is the training data behind UnifoLM-VLA-Base's Fold Towel task.

name: Z1 Dual Dex1 FoldClothes Dataset
description: Unitree Z1 dual-arm (14 DoF) fold-clothes dataset with Dex1 parallel-grip end-effectors. Task: fold a T-shirt with the Unitree logo. 100–200 sec per episode, 4 cameras @ 30 Hz. Not G1 but same Dex1 hand; useful as a cross-embodiment reference for cloth manipulation on the Unitree ecosystem.
provenance_notes: Verified via WebFetch. Referenced by Flameyyyyy's Z1 diffusion-policy fold-clothes checkpoint already in the policies catalog.

name: G1 WBT Inspire Collect Clothes (Main Cam Only)
description: Real Unitree G1 whole-body teleoperated (WBT) dataset: the humanoid picks up and collects clothes using Inspire hands (multi-finger, dexterous). Main-camera-only variant — lower storage footprint. Part of Unitree's laundry-pipeline data collection.
provenance_notes: Found in Unitree's HF org listing during research. Episode count not recorded at fetch time; user should verify.

name: G1 WBT Inspire Put Clothes Into Washing Machine
description: Real Unitree G1 whole-body teleoperated dataset: the humanoid loads clothes into a washing machine using Inspire hands. Laundry-pipeline task, upstream of folding.
provenance_notes: Found in Unitree's HF org listing. Inspire hands variant.

name: G1 WBT Dex1 Put Clothes Into Washing Machine
description: Real Unitree G1 whole-body teleoperated dataset: the humanoid loads clothes into a washing machine using Dex1 parallel grippers. Same task as the Inspire variant, different end-effector.
provenance_notes: Found in Unitree's HF org listing. Dex1 hands variant — same gripper family as the G1_Dex1_Fold_Towel dataset.

name: G1 WBT Inspire Put Clothes Into Basket
description: Real Unitree G1 whole-body teleoperated dataset: the humanoid picks clothes and places them into a basket, using Inspire hands. Part of Unitree's laundry-pipeline data collection.
provenance_notes: Found in Unitree's HF org listing. Inspire hands variant.
